exposure: Pregnancies with abortive outcomes (including ectopic pregnancy)
outcome: Fetal or neonatal outcomes (proportion discharged home with mother)
cohort: Mothers experiencing live births, maternal near misses, or maternal deaths in participating facilities in Namibia during the study period.
finding: During a 6-month surveillance period, 37,106 live births, 298 maternal near misses (8.0 per 1000 live births), and 23 maternal deaths (62.0 per 100,000 live births) were recorded, with obstetric haemorrhage and hypertensive disorders being the most common causes of near misses, and only 50.3% of infants born to near-miss mothers going home with their mother.
